title: Early Access Release
body: Initial public launch of Euler Desktop. Complete with local version history, unlimited file sizes, and high-performance rust-based diffing engine. Supports PSD, BLEND, MP4, and standard image formats.

title: Beta Testing
body: Closed beta for internal artists. Added the visual branching UI and fast search features.

title: Alpha Core
body: The very first conceptual build. Prototyped the Tauri + Rust environment.
